title: AI Agent Studio: guided building, workflows and inspected runs
summary: Expand Agent Studio into eight educational modules with seven projects, a connected editor, local debugger, optional server tool loop and a versioned portfolio.

changes.detail: Eight lessons with knowledge checks; six-step builder; editable node connections and optional zoomable graph; seven working local project starters; step timeline, retry injection, approvals and evaluation cases.

Owner-authenticated, rate-limited and opt-in Responses API tool loop with server-only credentials, fixed read-only tool registry, validation, turn/token/time bounds and a disabled-by-default server switch.
Immutable local portfolio versions and JSON exports containing configuration, recorded run, TypeScript/Python SDK teaching examples and documentation. Production status remains not deployed.
The Agent Studio entry opens the expanded module; the original beginner workshop and its storage are preserved at /agent-studio-basics.

validation.name: Implementation checks
validation.detail: TypeScript, focused lint, behavioral and UI tests, backend failure mocks and export verification pending. Official OpenAI function-calling and SDK quickstart/state/guardrail/orchestration/tracing pages fetched on 2026-10-16. No real provider call or deployment.
